sshHostServer.tunnelUnsupported: This host isn’t supported by this version of Adehone: its SSH server doesn’t allow port forwarding, and Adehone couldn’t reach its server through the SSH session either. To keep using it, install an older version of Adehone.

sshHostServer.updateDeferredLater: Runs Adehone’s server; it updates on a later connect.

metric.footprintDescription: Summed memory footprint, the same figure Activity Monitor shows: memory each process owns, including graphics memory. Pages shared between processes are not counted twice.
metric.privateBytesDescription: Summed private bytes: memory these processes have committed, counted whether it is resident or paged out. This is what the host charges against its commit limit, so it keeps rising while the working set above shrinks under paging.
metric.rssDescription: Summed resident set size (RSS). Shared or aliased pages can appear in more than one process.
metric.workingSetDescription: Summed working set (WS): pages resident in RAM right now. Shared pages can appear in more than one process, and memory Windows has paged out is not counted here.

quitAndStopAllSessions.detail: Adehone closes every terminal tab and stops its session, including agents running in terminals, then quits. Plain Quit keeps them running so Adehone reattaches on next launch. Terminal sessions on remote hosts may keep running there. result.automationsPendingOne: One automation is off on the host for now. Adehone keeps asking the host to turn it back on.
result.browserLoginsConflict: Browser logins were not copied, because the host’s browser profile is already in use. Sign in again in the host’s browser tabs.
result.browserLoginsHostUnknown: Browser logins were not copied, because Adehone could not identify the host’s browser profile. Sign in again in the host’s browser tabs.
result.browserLoginsNotCopied: Browser logins were not copied to the host. Sign in again in the host’s browser tabs.
result.droppedForMappedDrives: Not moved, because their drive letter no longer points into {{distro}}: {{names}}. Check the drive, then move them again.
result.moved: Reload this window to see the projects under the {{distro}} host. Adehone backs up unsaved files before it reloads.
result.reloadCheckpointRefused: Adehone could not back up unsaved files, so the window did not reload. Close this dialog, save or close those files, then use Reload now in the notice that stays open.
result.reloadFailed: The window did not reload. Try again.
result.reloadVetoed: Something kept the window from reloading. Close this dialog, save your work, then use Reload now in the notice that stays open.
result.reset: The move stopped and everything was put back. The projects work on this computer as before; paused terminals start again when you open them.
result.undoHint: Changed your mind? After the reload, the sidebar lists these projects as “Moved to {{distro}} host”. Choose “Use on this computer again” there to bring them back as they were before the move.
result.waiting: The move may have reached the {{distro}} host, but the host is not answering. These projects stay read-only here until it does. Connect the host in Settings, then open this dialog again and start a move: Adehone finishes or undoes this one first.

runtime.description: This project runs in {{distro}} through this computer. Move it to the {{distro}} host to run it there.
runtime.label: Project runtime

scopeRefused.gitUnreadable: Orca couldn’t read its Git details in time to check them, so it stays on this computer. Check again in a moment.
scopeRefused.mappedDriveUnverifiable: Orca couldn’t check where its drive letter points just now. Make sure the drive is connected, then check again.
scopeRefused.mixedLocations: Some of its folders are outside this distro, so it stays on this computer.
scopeRefused.notLocal: It already runs on another host.
scopeRefused.windowsDrive: Its folder is on a Windows drive, so it stays on this computer.
scopeRefused.windowsGitDir: Its Git folder is linked by a Windows path (a worktree or a separate Git folder Git for Windows set up), which Git on the WSL host can’t follow.
scopeRefused.windowsGitWorktrees: Git for Windows recorded some of its worktrees, including any since deleted, and Git on the WSL host can’t use those records. Remove those worktrees, or run git worktree repair from WSL, then move it.

unfinished.many: {{n}} automations moved to the {{distro}} host are still off. Adehone keeps asking the host to turn them back on.
unfinished.one: One automation moved to the {{distro}} host is still off. Adehone keeps asking the host to turn it back on.
